content.text: In regions where conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, building a reliable digital store can feel impossible. You need an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-4|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] that doesn't just work but thrives under pressure. This guide details how to set up your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|Crypto Payment]] store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-what-actually-10|cloudflare]] Pages, ensuring you can accept payments seamlessly without relying on traditional payment processors. Get ready to take control of your commerce capabilities and launch your online store efficiently.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to empower digital creators who are often locked out of conventional payment systems. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you build an autonomous commerce environment that guarantees ownership and control over your digital assets. This architecture eliminates the dependency on third-party platforms, ensuring that your store remains operational even during financial instability or currency collapse. You become the sole custodian of your business, where scalability and sustainability are at your fingertips.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin the deployment process, ensure you have a domain name ready for your store. You’ll need a basic understanding of Cloudflare Pages and GitHub to host your site. Additionally, prepare your digital products and organize them for upload. Familiarize yourself with how to configure Google Apps Script for backend logic and ensure you have a NOWPayments account set up to handle cryptocurrency transactions. By gathering all necessary components upfront, you can streamline the deployment process and get your store live faster.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your backend using Cloudflare Workers, which will handle the logic for order processing. Next, integrate NOWPayments to accept multiple cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Once your payment gateway is configured, set up file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that customers receive their products instantly after payment confirmation. This seamless pipeline guarantees that once payment is made, fulfillment is automatic, enhancing customer satisfaction and reducing the burden on you.
Take ownership of your digital commerce with a self-hosted solution.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After configuring your store and payment system, it’s time to go live. Test your setup thoroughly before promoting your store. Process a test transaction to confirm that everything works as intended, from payment to file delivery. Once you’re satisfied with your store's functionality, launch your site and begin promoting it through social media and digital marketing channels. The first transaction is crucial, as it sets the stage for your business's credibility and operational success.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is operational, consider ways to scale. Leverage Cloudflare's edge network to improve load times and customer experience. Expand your product offerings by uploading more digital products and integrating additional marketing tools. Regularly analyze transaction data through Supabase to understand customer behavior and refine your sales strategies. By continuously enhancing your store's capabilities, you position yourself for sustainable growth in the digital marketplace.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, deploy on Cloudflare Pages using a combination of workers and NOWPayments for seamless transaction processing. This architecture enables you to maintain control over your products and payments without relying on traditional platforms. Follow the detailed steps in this guide for a successful setup.
Integrate crypto payments seamlessly for fast and secure transactions.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Stack 01 and how does it differ from Stack 02?

Stack 01 is deployed using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for setup. In contrast, Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Workers, allowing for faster deployment within 48 hours, and offers more advanced features like Supabase integration.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent choices for hosting a digital product store. They provide reliable, free hosting solutions that can easily integrate with payment processors like NOWPayments for crypto transactions.
How do I ensure my payment processing is secure?

Utilize NOWPayments for secure cryptocurrency transactions. This platform offers automatic verification of payments and supports various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring that your transactions are secure and reliable.
What are the benefits of using Cloudflare Workers?

Cloudflare Workers offer an efficient way to run backend logic without managing servers. They enhance the performance of your application by executing code closer to your users, resulting in faster response times and a better overall experience.
How can I handle product delivery effectively?

You can handle product delivery through services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. By integrating these services, you ensure that customers receive their digital products instantly and automatically after the payment is confirmed.
